title: Require executable evidence for supported capability claims
scope: Connect each supported capability slice to non-default, stage-specific executable evidence so broad probe equality cannot certify support.
acceptance: For each supported stage, record and validate the source or synthetic non-default case, asserted stage, exact field/wire/dispatch obligation, expected loss-report behavior, and retaining independent consumer or explicit justified limit.

Reuse or extend the semantic ledger and its executable assertion records. Mere strings naming a test, aggregate probe equality, default-only cases or a capability association must not satisfy the requirement.
Sensitivity checks must reject a supported claim whose non-default case, stage assertion, serialization assertion, required report assertion or independent evidence is removed or mismatched.

Keep unsupported, unverified, default-only and blocked comparisons visible and distinguish source-side from target-side consumer failures. Update the closure workflow and migrate existing claims without falsely promoting them.
exclusions: A new standalone manifest is an implementation option, not a required architecture. No blanket waiver for existing raw differences.

reproduction.instructions: For each supported stage, record and validate the source or synthetic non-default case, asserted stage, exact field/wire/dispatch obligation, expected loss-report behavior, and retaining independent consumer or explicit justified limit. See the linked investigation decision and review receipt for the confirmed baseline.

evidence.detail: implementation-ready: Current capabilities link source/tests but do not enforce all five closure evidence roles; existing ledger and sensitivity machinery can supply the enforceable contract.

Reviewed claim-site binding and executable primary/wire/report/independent receipts, scoped limits, migration, and negative/sensitivity checks for deleted or redirected obligations. Default-only, unresolved, source-blocked and target-blocked comparisons remain distinct. This verifies the evidence gate, not every value in every supported capability. The separately reproduced #47/#50/#79 failures remain open and visible.
commands: prek run --all-files: PASS on the reviewed commit
node conformance/capabilities/probe.mjs: completed all 364 inputs; raw fixture receipts unchanged; limitations reviewed
python3 conformance/capabilities/manage.py refresh && python3 conformance/capabilities/manage.py check: PASS

resolution: The semantic ledger now requires one assertion-site receipt for each supported catalog stage. Each receipt emits its exact source, value, stage, and primary obligation from the assertion. Export receipts also emit exact serialization and report assertions from the same claim context. AlphaTab callbacks emit the matching independent claim identity. The database stores all 159 supported-stage claims. One prior supported rating was downgraded because its evidence used an unrelated obligation. The runtime probe keeps default-only rows and source or target consumer blockers visible.
